task_summary: Plan a bounded revision to the Meridian Returns support macro that preserves eligibility rules, clarifies escalation, and removes unsupported promises.

decision_record.decision: Replace case-by-case final-sale language with a firm ineligibility statement.
decision_record.risk: Flexible wording could weaken the rule.

decision_record.decision: Require eligibility confirmation before presenting either refund path.
decision_record.because: Store credit or an original-payment refund is available only after eligibility is confirmed.
decision_record.risk: Early remedy language could imply approval.

decision_record.decision: Route unreadable receipt images to escalation.
decision_record.because: The receipt cannot support an eligibility decision when unreadable.
decision_record.risk: Vague escalation wording could invite unsupported handling.
Alternative timing language could create a new promise.

proposed_change_manifest.change: State the 30-day request limit, final-sale exclusion, unreadable-receipt escalation, post-confirmation refund options, and absence of a same-day promise.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: Keep required facts separate from optional wording.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Remove case-by-case final-sale consideration and any same-day refund commitment; clarify escalation and eligibility sequencing.
proposed_change_manifest.reason: Correct the two known conflicts without expanding policy.

proposed_change_manifest.change: Require reviewer confirmation of all five rule facts and no extra promise.

acceptance_mapping.evidence: Outcome contract limits returns to requests made within 30 days.
Plan replaces case-by-case wording with final-sale ineligibility.
Unreadable receipt images are routed to escalation.
Store credit or original-payment refund appears only after eligibility confirmation.
Plan removes the same-day refund promise and adds no timing substitute.
Fixed checklist requires review of all five rule facts and confirmation that no extra promise was added.
